verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence that Lago shows current-cycle usage or accrued cost to customers or the team in real time, and nothing on usage thresholds or pre-invoice alerts. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: per-customer revenue-analytics dashboards, editing usage charges via API or UI, and a generic 'real-time monetization platform' tagline. This is an applicable axis for a billing platform, so absent evidence means 'none'.

support.subject: As an ops user, customers and my team can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time, with thresholds and alerts before an invoice surprises anyone
